b:
In the valley years,
Before the checks arrive, low
Is the taxman's claim.

From the deferred vault,
A sum is lifted, taxed light,
Into the Roth's arms.

The bill, paid elsewhere —
From taxable, set aside —
So the gift stays whole.

Fill the bracket now,
Watch the IRMAA threshold line,
While the rates are kind.

The harvest, though small,
Will outshine the tax that time
Would otherwise bind.
